articles.title: Rött på Wall Street - chipjättar mot strömmen
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Rött på Wall Street - chipjättar mot strömmen
articles.body_text: Wall Street var stängt i måndags på grund av Labor Day. Arkivbild. Rött på Wall Street - chipjättar mot strömmen De ledande indexen på Wall Street lös röda när handelsveckan drog i gång efter Labor Day. Dow Jones industriindex dök 1,2 procent, breda S&P 500 sjönk 0,6 procent och tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex tappade 0,3 procent. Förutom de fortsatta attackerna i Mellanöstern oroas marknaden av nya amerikanska inflationssiffror som släpps på fredag, vilket är det sista viktiga beskedet inför centralbanken Federal Reserves möte i nästa vecka. Sannolikheten för en höjning av styrräntan är just nu 60 procent, enligt analysföretaget CME Fed Watch. Mot strömmen i tisdagens handel gick chiptillverkaren Qualcomm sedan bolaget meddelat ett partnerskap med Amazon för att bygga ut AI-infrastruktur. Aktien lyfte 3,2 procent. Processortillverkaren Intels aktie stack i väg upp 9,1 procent efter uppgifter i Digitimes om att ytterligare prishöjningar väntar.

articles.title: Viktig signal med sanktioner – men Trumps ord räknas
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Viktig signal från Storbritannien – men det är Trumps ord som räknas
articles.body_text: Arkiv: Donald Trump / Israeliska bosättningar på Västbanken (montage) Den positiva tolkningen av Storbritanniens besked är att tvåstatslösningen där Palestina och Israel lever sida vid sida kanske inte är död. Åtminstone har britterna idag gjort extra tydligt att de inte vill se bosättare förstöra den ockuperade Västbanken och möjligheten till en framtid i fred. Britterna har idag agerat i såväl ord som handling och det är en stor skillnad. Sanktionerna har visserligen förhållandevis liten praktisk betydelse eftersom handeln med Västbanken är liten. Men det är ett nytt språkbruk. Den förra brittiska regeringen under premiärminister Starmer använde inte orden etnisk rensning för att beskriva hur bosättarna behandlar palestinierna på Västbanken. Nu är ordvalet just det: Etnisk rensning. Storbritannien har ett särskilt arv i regionen på grund av Balfourdeklarationen 1917. Den gav judar rätten att skapa sig ett hem i Palestina. Men Balfourdeklarationen ses som ett stort svek bland palestinier eftersom hänsyn inte togs till att de redan bodde där. Som vanligt när det gäller historia så finns det inte bara en förklaring till länders relationer, men Balfourdeklarationen är bra att ha i bakhuvudet för att förstå vidden av uttalandet som den brittiska regeringen har gjort idag och de svar som Israels regering har kommit med. Det tycks som om den nya Labour-regeringen vill ta på sig ett moraliskt ansvar, men vi vet ännu inte hur problematiskt det blir. Orsaken är att USA:s president Trump ännu inte sagt hur han ställer sig till saken. Utrikesminister Rubio sa visserligen att USA inte tänker gå i britternas fotspår eftersom man tror att det skapar problem för att mäkla fred i Gaza. Men Rubio i all ära – det är Trumps dom mot Storbritannien som räknas. Storbritannien inför sanktioner mot bosättare

articles.title: EU och Kanada vill fördjupa relation
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: EU och Kanada vill fördjupa relation
articles.body_text: EU och Kanada vill fördjupa sin relation. På bilden syns EU-kommissionens ordförande Ursula von der Leyen och Kanadas premiärminister Mark Carney vid G7-mötet i somras. EU och Kanada arbetar för att fördjupa sin relation. En ny allians mellan parterna kommer att omfatta allt från handel till säkerhet. EU-kommissionens ordförande Ursula von der Leyen förväntas tillkännage planerna i EU-parlamentet i Strasbourg den 16 september. Kanadas premiärminister Mark Carney ska närvara och hålla ett tal dagen efter. Carney höll ett uppmärksammat tal tidigare i år där han dödförklarade den gamla USA-ledda världsordningen. Nu har Carney och hans regering gjort ett fördjupat partnerskap med EU till högsta prioritet och tittar på allt utom ett faktiskt EU-medlemskap, säger en kanadensisk källa till Bloomberg Diskussionerna är främst inriktade på frågor om ”strategiska förmågor”, som samarbete inom försvar, rymden och forskning. Parterna planerar också att hålla ett toppmöte i Kanada i oktober.

articles.title: Storbritannien inför sanktioner mot bosättare
articles.summary: ”Är olaglig”
articles.body_text: Storbritanniens utrikesminister Ed Miliband offentliggjorde sanktionerna i det brittiska underhuset på tisdagen. Arkivbild. Storbritannien inför sanktioner mot bosättare Storbritannien tillkännager omfattande sanktioner mot israeliska bosättningar på Västbanken. Israels ockupation på Västbanken är olaglig. Jag tillkännager att vi inför ett importförbud på varor tillverkade i bosättningar på Västbanken, säger utrikesminister Ed Miliband i det brittiska underhuset. Förra veckan uttryckte Storbritanniens utrikesminister Ed Miliband att landet kommer att ”lägga om kursen" i politiken gentemot Israel. På tisdagen gjordes beslutet offentligt. I väntan på sanktionsbeslutets offentliggörande, uppmanade Israels säkerhetsminister Ben-Gvir premiärminister Benjamin Netanyahu att stänga det brittiska konsulatet i östra Jerusalem, skriver BBC . Storbritannien har riktat skarp kritik mot Israels godkända planer på att bygga nya bosättningar öster om Jerusalem i det så kallade ”E1-området”. Planerna ”överträder en gräns”, ”de skär rakt igenom Västbanken och riskerar att göra förverkligandet av en palestinsk stat omöjlig”, har Ed Miliband sagt i det brittiska parlamentet. Bosättarvåld och trakasserier mot civila palestinier har ökat kraftigt de senaste åren. Det senaste dygnet har fyra palestinier på Västbanken dödats av israeliska styrkor, enligt palestinska myndigheter, skriver Haaretz . Israels 160 bosättningar på Västbanken är olagliga, strider mot internationell rätt och fördöms av en rad länder.

articles.title: Finansmannen dundrar mot näringslivets skattehot
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Finansmannen dundrar mot näringslivets skattehot
articles.body_text: Robert Weil, ordförande och grundare av Proventus, är inte nådig i sin kritik av svenska direktörer. Arkivbild. Finansmannen dundrar mot näringslivets skattehot Toppdirektörernas attack på miljardärsskatten är skamlig. Hotet mot svensk ekonomi och demokratin kommer från helt annat håll – högernationalismen, dundrar finansmannen Robert Weil. På senare tid har mängder av tongivande representanter från svenskt näringsliv målat upp förslagen på höjda skatter, främst en återinförd förmögenhetsskatt som V och MP vill se, som ett hot mot svensk ekonomi. ”Att representanter från Svenskt näringsliv sprider sådan skrämselpropaganda är djupt oansvarigt. Att kapitalet och den populistiska nationalismen just nu gör enad front är skamligt och riskerar att i grunden skada vår demokrati”, skriver Robert Weil, grundare av investeringsbolaget Proventus, på DN Kulturdebatt. Han skriver att han ”chockats av de senaste veckornas indirekta men knappast dolda attacker mot Centerpartiet och Socialdemokraterna”, som enligt honom är tillväxtorienterade partier.

articles.title: Så många utvisas trots jobb inom bristyrken
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Så många utvisas trots jobb inom bristyrken
articles.body_text: Vården skriker efter arbetskraft, men vårdprogrammet växer inte som det ska. Arkivbild. Så många utvisas trots jobb inom bristyrken 260 personer med jobb inom bristyrken, som undersköterska och elektriker, har fått ett utvisningsbeslut det senaste året, visar en granskning från Dagens Arbete . Den vanligaste orsaken till utvisning är att personernas liv har förändrats så att grunden för uppehållstillståndet inte längre gäller. De kan ha skiljt sig, blivit myndiga eller mist en anhörig. Näst vanligast är att lönen eller arbetsvillkoren inte når upp till de skärpta kraven. I genomsnitt har personerna bott i Sverige i fem år och elva månader. Många har också familj här. När de 260 personerna utvisas får också 84 barn lämna landet. Siffran över utvisade är troligtvis högre än 260, enligt DA, då man bara har kunnat räkna ärenden där yrkestiteln framgår i en genomgång av utvisningsärenden i migrationsdomstolarna.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: SVT Sport möter Graham Potter
articles.summary: I oktober 2025 tog engelsmannen Graham Potter över som förbundskapten för det svenska herrlandslaget i fotboll - efter att hans föregångare Jon Dahl Tomasson misslyckats med att ta Sverige direkt till fotbolls-VM. 50-årige Potter har ett förflutet som tränare för Premier League-klubbarna Brighton och Chelsea. Men för den svenska publiken är han kanske främst förknippad med sitt tränarjobb i Östersunds FK, som han tog från division 2 ända upp till allsvenskan. Så hur ska då Graham Potter vända den negativa trend som herrlandslaget befinner sig i? Har han vad som krävs för att Sverige ska ta sig till VM i sommar? Det och mycket annat frågade SVT Sports programledare André Pops honom.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: På ett ögonblick
articles.summary: Arne Bivrins stora passion är fågelfotografi. Han kliver in i en sagovärld och tar bilder som får folk att häpna, av ögonblick som bara existerar där och då. Efter en stor tragedi där hela livet förändrades på några sekunder överlevde han med hjälp av fotografin. Under ett år följer vi Arne när han tar sig an sitt livs största fotoprojekt. Naturfilm producerad av Emil Sergel.

articles.title: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
articles.summary: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.
articles.body_text: Israel's furious response to the British government's decision to ban trade with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank testifies to just how important this moment is. Britain took the brunt of Israel's anger, but the fact that 12 countries chose to move together clearly sharpened the sense of outrage. Officials in London always knew that such a dramatic shift in policy towards Israel-Palestine was going to elicit a hostile response, but seemed taken aback by the speed and ferocity of Israel's reaction. The closure of the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem, which serves the West Bank and deals directly with the Palestinian Authority in Ramallah, and the removal of British representatives from the International Gaza Support Centre, the body set up last year to co-ordinate stabilisation and relief efforts in the Gaza Strip, are very hostile moves. They tell you that Israel is deeply troubled by Tuesday's action by the UK and 11 other countries, which include France, Spain and Canada. Products manufactured in settlements may not represent a significant proportion of Israel's exports, but the political symbolism of singling these out for special treatment is powerful. For decades, the British and other governments have regarded settlements in occupied Palestinian territory as illegal but stopped short of banning products grown or manufactured there. Now, having announced that Britain agrees with the 2024 International Court of Justice ruling that the occupation as a whole - including Israel's military presence - is unlawful, Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband says the government's economic relationships must reflect that. Hence the ban, not just on products but also on companies that provide construction, infrastructure or finance to settlements. The measures, which also include restrictions on arms sales that "materially contribute to the occupation", go further than many expected. And it's not just the actions - it's the language of the foreign secretary's heartfelt, sometimes deeply personal statement that is so striking. As a "proud British Jew... unwavering in my support for the state of Israel," Miliband spoke more directly and starkly than practically any of his predecessors. That a British foreign secretary should say that "settler terrorism is rampant" and was responsible for the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians in parts of the West Bank, while the Israeli government "turned a blind eye to this" is truly remarkable.

articles.title: Fourteen go on trial over deadliest Channel small boats disaster
articles.summary: At least 30 men, women and children drowned when their dinghy capsized on 24 November 2021.
articles.body_text: Fourteen suspected people smugglers have gone on trial in Paris for their role in the worst ever small boats disaster in the English Channel. In November 2021, at least 30 men, women and children drowned when their motorised dinghy deflated and started taking on water halfway between France and the UK. The 14 defendants – mainly Afghan nationals – are accused of manslaughter and facilitating illegal immigration as part of an organised criminal group. Most of them deny the charges. Two of the 14, who are alleged to be leaders of the operation, remain on the run and are being tried in absentia. The boat left the French coast on the evening of 23 November 2021, but ran into difficulty in the middle of the Channel. One by one the occupants entered the water to try to lessen the weight, but succumbed to the cold and drowned. Only two men survived. According to the charge sheet, the defendants helped to launch "a small boat of poor quality, unfit to navigate at sea, overloaded and equipped with inadequate life-jackets". Twenty-seven bodies were found after the boat sank, and another four were confirmed missing. Many of the people who died were Iraqi Kurds, but others came from Somalia, Ethiopia, Egypt and Afghanistan. The youngest named victim was seven years old. Some family members travelled to Paris for the start of the trial, which is expected to last three weeks. "Once again [the smugglers displayed] total cynicism. Migrants are not sailors," said Emmanuel Daoud, a lawyer representing many of the families. "The smugglers know perfectly well what they are doing. They take the deliberate, conscious risk of sending migrants to their deaths."

articles.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
articles.summary: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.
articles.body_text: The UK has announced sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, accusing Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said the move marked the "beginning of a new approach" to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, which "not only calls out injustice and suffering but acts". Israel's Foreign Minister Gideon Saar responded by accusing him of spreading an "outrageous lie" and announced counter-measures including shutting the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem. The UK sanctions will ban settlement goods but also act against companies and individuals providing services for settlement expansion. The sanctions were launched alongside France and Canada, which in a joint statement with the UK said the action "marks a further turning point in our approach to protecting the two-state solution". Settlements are illegal under international law, and there has been a rise in violence towards Palestinians in the West Bank by settlers in recent months. In a statement to MPs, Miliband said: "The British government agrees that there is ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in areas of the West Bank, perpetrated by settler terrorists. "And all too often the Israeli government has turned a blind eye to this and worse, members of it have made statements and taken actions to support the forced displacement of Palestinians." He said ethnic cleansing was defined by the UN as a "purposeful policy designed by one ethnic or religious group to remove by violent means another ethnic or religious group from certain areas". Miliband said the official view of the government was that the Israeli occupation of the West Bank was unlawful because of the "entrenchment of its control, its intention to extend permanent sovereignty, and its expansionist agenda via illegal settlements". He said this position, which is in line with a 2024 advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice, should be reflected in the UK's "economic relationship" with the occupied West Bank. As a result, over the next six to nine months, the UK will introduce "a new comprehensive sanctions regime", he said.

articles.title: British widow faces deportation from Sweden after 22 years
articles.summary: A 78-year-old British woman is facing deportation for failing to fill out a Brexit residence application on time.
articles.body_text: A 78-year-old British widow has told the BBC she is struggling to eat or sleep as the Swedish government threatens to deport her over a late post-Brexit residence application. Joyce Thomas, a retired nurse, moved to Sweden 22 years ago with her husband, who passed away from cancer three years ago. The threat of deportation came after Swedish authorities said they should have made a formal application to stay in the country after Brexit. Thomas has since had numerous applications and appeals rejected, and Tuesday marks the latest deadline for her to leave voluntarily. "This is absolute hell," she said from her home in Sweden. "I can't sleep, I can't eat. You get up in the morning, you don't know what's going to happen." The Swedish migration minister told the BBC that the government would "examine whether there are measures we can take to make the process easier for those affected" by some consequences of the EU-UK withdrawal agreement. When the UK left the EU on 31 January 2020, British citizens stopped being EU citizens, which meant they could no longer stay in Sweden with right of residence status. During a transitional period, British citizens could apply for residence status under the withdrawal agreement between the UK and the EU - which ended on 31 December 2021. Thomas said she and her husband were unaware that they needed to submit an application and she was only informed of the rule once she attempted to re-enter the country in 2023. After years of appeals, the Migrationsverket, the Swedish government agency responsible for migration, told her last month that her voluntary departure deadline was 8 September. Her lawyers are arguing against the deportation, but she is still waiting to hear from the government.

articles.title: Sudan's healthcare system on brink of collapse after cuts, medical charity MSF warns
articles.summary: Médecins Sans Frontières is urging world leaders to increase funding to help the millions who need aid.
articles.body_text: Sudan's fragile health system is on the brink of collapse as global funding cuts have led to the closure of healthcare facilities across the country, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has warned. Dozens of organisations were unable to find alternative funding after the US - the largest donor to Sudan - closed USAID, its body for delivering foreign aid, last year, the medical charity said. MSF urged world leaders gathering at the UN General Assembly in New York to take action. The war that erupted in April 2023 between the army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) has created one of the worst humanitarian crises in the world, with more than 33 million people needing medical assistance. MSF said while the US was still the largest donor to Sudan, existing grants to many USAID-funded organisations ran out in June - as European governments were also reducing international assistance. According to the Paris-based Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), international aid fell globally by 21.3% in 2025 compared to the previous year. "War is driving Sudan's needs; funding cuts are shrinking the response," said Muhammad Ibrahim, the head of charity in Sudan. "MSF's work in Sudan is privately funded. But when funding disappears from other health services, clinics close, patients have fewer places to go, and pressure shifts to the facilities that remain, including ours." This has meant that patients often have to make dangerous and long trips to get treatment. "After a longer and more expensive journey, patients often arrive in a much more serious condition, and the hospital may already be full," explained Sebastián Traficante, MSF's emergency co-ordinator in the western region of Darfur, which has experienced much of the fighting over the last three years. Between January and April 2026, MSF saw admissions jump by 22.5% in facilities it supports in central Darfur, when compared to the same time last year. In May alone, 45 healthcare centres in the area had stopped receiving funding, it said.

articles.title: In West Bank, date farmers weigh impact of UK sanctions on Israeli settlers
articles.summary: Palestinians strongly back a ban on settlement goods, but Israel's government says it is a "big mistake".
articles.body_text: Juicy brown and ripening yellow dates dangle down from the branches of each palm tree at Israeli settler farms in the Jordan Valley, in the occupied West Bank. This year, as Israeli growers get ready for a good harvest, they are also preparing for the impact of new Western sanctions against settlements, which are illegal under international law. The UK government has announced an import ban on settlement goods and said it planned to take action against companies and individuals who provide services for settlement expansion, as part of what it calls a "comprehensive reset" of policy towards Israel following similar moves by several other European countries. Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Iceland, Ireland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain and Sweden have also confirmed their intention to introduce national restrictions, or support European restrictions, on trade in goods with settlements. Palestinians strongly back such a move, but Israel's foreign minister called it "hostile" and announced a series of counter measures, including the closure of the British consulate in East Jerusalem. Israeli date farmer Avigdor Arbel, from the settlement of Mesua, calls such boycotts "really disgusting". Arbel sells his produce mostly to Europe but also to the US and now, India. However, he says the sector is ready for any new UK ban on settler goods. "As soon as we have a situation of pressure and boycotts, we always break out and look for other markets," he tells me. "So, I believe that if we get to a situation in which there's no place to sell my fruits in Europe, we'll find other markets." West Bank settlements have expanded rapidly under the current Israeli government, whose ministers say they want "to bury the idea" of an independent Palestinian state - part of the long-standing international formula for peace in the region known as the two-state solution. At the same time, settler violence against Palestinians has surged to what the UN says is "an all-time high". With new settler outposts - which are also illegal under Israeli law - now dotting the barren hilltops of the Jordan Valley, there have been repeated attacks on local Palestinians, particularly Bedouin and herding communities. In January, the last of some 600 villagers fled their homes in Ras Ein al-Ouja after intense harassment by hardline settlers, often backed by Israeli security forces. It was the largest single displacement of a Palestinian community in the past three years.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
articles.summary: The Iran-backed Yemeni group's attacks have injured 73 people and caused fires at oil facilities, Saudi authorities say.
articles.body_text: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement has attacked energy facilities and other civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia with dozens of drones and missiles, injuring 73 people, Saudi authorities say. Tuesday's attacks hit four south-western cities, causing fires at oil facilities and installations that led to a temporary halt in operations, according to Saudi Arabia's military and energy ministry. The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said that its forces would respond to the "dangerous escalation". The Houthis said the attacks were retaliation for dozens of recent Saudi strikes on areas of north-western Yemen that they control. On Monday, they accused Saudi Arabia of bombing a prison in the city of al-Hazm and killing at least 11 people. Twenty inmates are reportedly missing under the rubble. The spokesman for the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, Maj Gen Turki al-Maliki, said the Houthi drone and missile attacks targeted civilian and economic sites in the cities of Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran, and that women and children were among the injured. An energy ministry statement cited an official source as saying that injuries were also reported after "several energy sector facilities and installations" were targeted. The attacks "caused fires at several locations, leading to a temporary halt in some operations," they added. Maliki described Houthi attacks as a "dangerous escalation that confirms the hostile and irresponsible approach of this terrorist militia" and said the Saudi-led coalition would "take all necessary operational measures to deter" the group. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Sarea accused the Saudi military of carrying out more than 120 air strikes on the Yemeni provinces of Marib, al-Bayda, Hudaydah, Taiz and Jawf over the past three days, and of committing "grave crimes". He said the Houthis had responded to this "brutal aggression" with "dozens of ballistic missiles and drones", which he claimed caused "significant damage". A Saudi-led coalition of Arab states has backed Yemen's government against the Houthis in the country's devastating civil war for more than a decade.

articles.title: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
articles.summary: It is the latest in a string of high-profile art thefts in Europe that has again put the security of museums and galleries in the spotlight.
articles.body_text: Two paintings by the impressionist artist Pierre-Auguste Renoir have been stolen from a museum in the south of France. Two thieves broke into the Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer early on Tuesday, seizing four paintings but dropping two of the works in the museum gardens as they escaped, local Mayor Bryan Masson said. The paintings, each worth €9m (£7.7m; $10.4m), are the latest high-profile pieces to have been stolen in a string of recent heists in Europe which have thrust the security of art in galleries and museums into the spotlight. One of the most high-profile was in October last year, when a brazen heist at the Louvre Museum in Paris saw France's priceless crown jewels being stolen. CCTV footage captured the thieves entering the Renoir museum gardens by cutting through a fence before they cut through structures holding the paintings' frames in place, the local mayor said. The alarm went off at 05:48 (03:48 GMT), and police were at the scene within five minutes, Masson explained, saying the thieves fled the scene upon hearing the security alarms. He later told reporters that the thieves seemed to be "well-equipped" and "well-informed". They were "wearing helmets, gloves, and combat gear" and carrying "an electric knife and hacksaw," he added. Investigators have found two zip-up bags at the scene, which may have belonged to the suspects. The mayor said that two paintings were "abandoned" in the gardens and have now been recovered. articles.title: New Yorkers were 'lied' to about toxic air after 9/11 attacks, says Mamdani
articles.summary: Newly released documents show toxins lingered for months after the attacks, but officials told people it was safe.
articles.body_text: Toxic air quality was being recorded in Manhattan soon after the 9/11 attacks even as officials played down health risks to the public, according to a trove of newly released files. Asbestos was found "nearly everywhere" tested near Ground Zero, where the World Trade Center towers collapsed in 2001, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said. "People got sick because the leaders they trusted lied and told them they were safe to breathe in toxic air," he said, announcing the release of 170,000 documents related to the attacks. Illnesses related to the dust and smoke from the towers' collapse have claimed more lives than the nearly 3,000 who died in the attacks, US health officials say. Thousands of people have experienced health effects like cancer, including many who have died, after breathing in hazardous contaminants after the Twin Towers collapsed. Speaking alongside Mamdani at Tuesday's news conference, TV host and 9/11 survivor advocate Jon Stewart said the new files show the city knew by October 2001 - a month after the terrorist attacks - that the air in Manhattan was toxic. "So to be fair to them, they only buried that information for 25 years," he said sarcastically. The records show asbestos was found near Ground Zero for months after the attacks at the same time people were being advised it was safe to go there. The files, which include air-quality reports and communications among city officials, include October 2001 correspondence known as the "Harding Memo". In it, an aide warned former Deputy Mayor Robert Harding that the city could face as many as 35,000 legal claims for its response to the attacks. The document states that the city could be sued because health advisories caused individuals "to return to the area too soon (causing toxic exposure or emotional harm)". City officials also told citizens to clean up dust and debris with "wet mops and rags" despite the presence of asbestos, which is only supposed to be cleaned by licensed professionals, according to another memo documenting the concerns of congressman Jerry Nadler.

articles.title: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
articles.summary: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.
articles.body_text: The Argentine government has said that it will file criminal charges against oil company Navitas Petroleum for operating in seas off the Falkland Islands. The move came just days after Argentine President Javier Milei said he would sanction oil companies drilling in the British overseas territory in the south-west Atlantic Ocean. Reacting to the news, Foreign Office Minister Kirsty McNeill insisted that there could be "no doubt" about the British government's commitment to the Falkland Islanders. Sovereignty of the archipelago remains disputed between the UK and Argentina more than 40 years after a British military task force ejected Argentine forces which had invaded the territory in 1982. Speaking in the House of Commons on Tuesday, McNeill said that "the decision by the Falkland Islands government to pursue hydrocarbon production is a commercial decision for them to take alongside the commercial companies involved". She added that "the future of the Falkland Islands is for Falkland Islanders to determine". The simmering dispute between Britain and Argentina over the Falklands heated up last week, when Milei said in a speech to the nation that the "winds of change" favoured Argentina's claim to the islands. Milei has, in the past, been criticised by Argentine veterans of the 1982 conflict for being "too soft" on the Falklands, which Argentines call Las Malvinas. In his speech on Thursday evening local time, Milei restated his government's position on the territory, saying "the Malvinas are Argentine, historically and legally... there's no debate about that." The president described drilling for oil in the archipelago as a "clear and urgent danger" to Argentine sovereignty. He also dismissed the result of a 2013 referendum in which 99.8% of the islands' residents voted in favour of the Falklands remaining a British oversees territory. Milei argued that they were living on land which had been "usurped" by the British and therefore "have no legitimate right to self-determination".

articles.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
articles.summary: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"
articles.body_text: A Russian drone has struck a Ukrainian TV channel headquarters in Kyiv, injuring at least five people as journalists were broadcasting live, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said. Zelensky said the daytime attack was a "new page in Russian degradation", while photos shared by the president showed a partially collapsed building. At least five people have been killed in overnight and daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv. A separate attack on a passenger train in southern Ukraine killed a female employee, officials have said. Both countries had earlier agreed to halt strikes on each other's capitals for three days while US Donald Trump's top envoys visited Moscow and Kyiv over the weekend. Referring to Tuesday's Russian drone attack on the Ukrainian TV channel We Are Ukraine, Zelensky said: "Today, Russia carried out a strike on the media, journalists. "Russia must be stopped, and this is possible only through joint efforts," he added in a renewed plea to Ukraine's allies in Europe, the US and around the world. We Are Ukraine has published footage which it says shows the moment the drone hit its newsroom. "The footage confirms that this was not an accidental strike, but a deliberate attack targeting journalists," the channel said in a post on Telegram. A BBC team later visited the site, confirming that the TV channel's newsroom was damaged in the strike, which reportedly interrupted the live broadcast. Earlier on Tuesday, air raid alerts warned civilians to seek shelter as Russian forces carried out missile and drone strikes on Kyiv, the local authorities said. A series of explosions across Ukraine's capital overnight killed three people and injured another 25, the state emergencies service DSNS said. Residential buildings were hit, including a five-storey house in the Solomianskyi district, while vehicles caught fire in the Podilskyi district.

articles.title: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
articles.summary: Canada's levies - as high as 50% - will apply to nearly $20bn of US products, from steel to T-shirts.
articles.body_text: Prime Minister Mark Carney has said that Canada's pivot away from the US as its largest trading partner "will come at a cost", as a wave of Canadian retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force. In a video address, Carney added that the counter-tariffs against the US "are necessary to protect our workers". Canada's levies will apply to nearly C$28bn ($20bn; £15bn) of American products, from steel to furniture to cotton T-shirts, and will be as high as 50%. Both US and Canadian officials have said they would like to strike a deal, but no new talks have been scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August. In Tuesday morning's 15-minute video address, Carney said his country's main focus was to diversify its trade relationships and build its economy. He added that his government would also support workers affected by the ongoing trade war with the US "for as long as it takes". "We have everything we need to pivot and prosper," the prime minister said. "That pivot will come at a cost. "There's always a cost to action, but it doesn't come close to the cost of standing still." US trade representative Jamieson Greer meanwhile said that Washington would consider imposing tit-for-tat tariffs on Canada as early as Tuesday. "We'll see this afternoon," he said in French, speaking to CBC News. President Donald Trump threatened on Monday to halt all US business with Canada-based airplane maker Bombardier unless it moved its manufacturing south. The aerospace giant is one of the largest in the country, contributing over C$7bn to Canada's annual GDP in 2024, according to a report by accounting firm PwC that was commissioned by Bombardier.

articles.title: Tukaram Mundhe: Maharashtra food safety officer who is a social media star
articles.summary: Tukaram Mundhe has gone viral after a series of aggressive inspections of restaurants to detect hygiene lapses.
articles.body_text: Cockroaches scurry across kitchen floors. Spider webs cling to walls. Spoiled vegetables rot in corners, while food counters show signs of pest infestation. One might assume these scenes belong to a struggling restaurant. But the photos are from a members-only club in Mumbai - India's financial capital and the capital of its richest state Maharashtra. They are among dozens of photos and videos that have gone viral since May, after Maharashtra's Food and Drug Administration (FDA) began a series of inspections at restaurants, cafes and other food businesses across the state. At the centre of the crackdown is 51-year-old civil servant Tukaram Mundhe, the state's new food commissioner. Since taking charge in May, Mundhe has overseen thousands of inspections and says food safety laws must be enforced regardless of a business's size, influence or reputation. "These actions are taken in public health interest. We will continue to take them against violations," Mundhe told the BBC. The campaign has made Mundhe a recognisable face across India, rare for a civil servant. Videos of his inspections and press briefings circulate widely on social media, where reels and podcasts have turned him into an unlikely celebrity. But the spotlight - and the controversy that often comes with it - is nothing new to him. An officer in the Indian Administrative Service, Mundhe has more than two decades of experience and has been transferred so often that reports say the number exceeds his years in service, though he declines to confirm it. "I have stopped counting my transfers," he told the BBC. Admirers see the transfers as evidence of his uncompromising style. Critics argue that this confrontational approach has put him at odds with colleagues and elected representatives.

articles.title: AI will cure cancer in our lifetime, claims boss of UK chip giant
articles.summary: Arm Holding's chief executive Rene Haas says artificial intelligence will find a solution to the disease.
articles.body_text: The boss of the biggest UK-headquartered tech firm has said that artificial intelligence will find a cure for cancer that humans cannot in our lifetimes. Rene Haas, chief executive of Cambridge-based chip designer Arm Holdings, said while modelling how a DNA marker is impacted by cancer was currently "too complex" a problem, computers are "going to solve it" in the future. Haas also told the BBC that AI would lead to widespread humanoid robots in the next five years, but that its current rapid growth was being held up by a shortage of chips needed to build data centres. However, he was sceptical about the idea chips could be manufactured in the UK in the future. Arm designs the brains or CPUs of microchips already used in hundreds of billions of phones, cars, smartwatches and gadgets across the globe. Earlier this summer, the company's peak share price amid the AI boom made it, in cash terms, the most valuable UK-based company in history. Haas, who stepped down from the board of British pharmaceutical giant AstraZeneca in April, told the BBC's Big Boss Interview podcast : "AI is going to... find a cure for cancer that today you and I, other humans [could] not in our lifetimes. I believe in our lifetime, AI will help cure cancer. "Modelling a cell, modelling a human, modelling how a DNA marker is impacted by cancer - it's too complex a problem, not only for humans today, but the computers that run AI. "However, going forward, as we feed more and more of the models into these computers, and the computers get more sophisticated to run the models, they're going to solve it," said Haas, who also holds a key role in Arm's main owner, the Japan-based Softbank, which has a range of investments in tech including in OpenAI. Prof Chris Bakal, from the Institute of Cancer Research, London, and CEO of Sentinal4D, said the real question was no longer whether we use AI, it's what we feed it. He said in labs like his, they are training AI on data generated themselves from patient samples. "It is not scraped from the internet. It does not need a giant data centre to run. The future of medical AI will not belong to whoever builds the biggest computer. It will belong to whoever has the right measurements.

articles.body_text: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, se decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga. Carlos Vilela, director nacional de Educación del JNE, declaró a Canal N que iniciarán el diálogo para alcanzar consensos con las agrupaciones políticas. “Buscamos de manera democrática poder decidir si ellos quieren que participe, por ejemplo, el primer candidato de la lista que postulan (...) Posiblemente se decida lo mismo, o solo se decida como en elecciones presidenciales, que solo vayan los candidatos. Eso lo vamos a saber este día lunes”. Renovación Popular ha enviado un pedido escrito al JNE para permitir la presentación de Rafael López Aliaga en el debate para la Municipalidad de Lima a pesar de que es candidato a teniente alcalde y no a la alcaldía, ya que este puesto estaba ocupado por Luis Rubio, quien renunció a su postulación. La cita técnica del lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 también servirá para definir las metodologías oficiales de los encuentros democráticos. Asimismo, los representantes partidarios elegirán a los profesionales independientes que asumirán las tareas de moderación en las transmisiones. “Nosotros invitamos a los representantes de Renovación Popular para que puedan asistir y ser partícipes del diálogo de esa propuesta”. Finalmente, Vilela exhortó al partido de López Aliaga que se sume a firmar el Pacto Ético Electoral de forma extemporánea, como lo hicieron el Partido Democrático Verde y Podemos Perú. El proceso electoral cuenta con más de 13,000 candidatos aptos para las elecciones del domingo 4 de octubre de 2026. Los debates representan un reto logístico importante para el JNE debido al alto número de postulaciones inscritas a nivel nacional. Los debates oficiales del JNE se desarrollarán de manera descentralizada desde el martes 8 de setiembre hasta el sábado 19 de setiembre de 2026. Para la Municipalidad de Lima, la exposición de propuestas quedó programada para el domingo 21 y el lunes 22 de setiembre de 2026. El cronograma electoral establece que el debate regional del Callao se realizará el miércoles 16 de setiembre de 2026. Por su parte, la región de Lima Provincias tendrá dos jornadas de diálogo democrático programadas para el jueves 17 y el viernes 18 de setiembre de 2026.

articles.body_text: El Consejo de Ministros que lidera Luis Galarreta sesiona hoy viernes 4 de setiembre desde las 6 p.m. en el Palacio de Gobierno de Lima. Esta cita de carácter ordinario reúne a los integrantes del gabinete para evaluar, entre otros puntos, la Política General del Gobierno. Según la agenda oficial, esta iniciativa está comprendida en un proyecto de Decreto Supremo que aprueba esta política para el periodo 2026-2031 y busca “ordenar el Estado para recuperar la seguridad, destrabar el crecimiento y convertir las decisiones públicas en resultados, propuesto por la Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros”. Horas atrás, la presidenta Keiko Fujimori participó en actividades oficiales visitando el BAP Paita en la Base Naval del Callao, acompañada por los ministros Rafael Belaúnde y Marco Vinelli. La agenda de trabajo del Consejo de Ministros de este viernes incluye la presentación de un reporte sobre el cumplimiento del Plan Multisectorial ante Lluvias Intensas. La Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros expondrá las acciones preventivas frente a riesgos climáticos ejecutadas durante el primer semestre del año 2026. El Ministerio de la Mujer expondrá las respuestas del sector frente a los casos de violencia sexual contra menores en Condorcanqui. Por su parte, el Ministerio del Interior presentará el proyecto de ley que facilita el chatarreo de vehículos de la Policía Nacional. El gabinete analizará las solicitudes de prórroga del estado de emergencia para distritos de Chupaca y Huancayo afectados por movimientos sísmicos. Asimismo, el Ministerio de Defensa someterá a votación la resolución legislativa que autoriza el ingreso de personal militar extranjero al territorio nacional. El Ejecutivo espera el pronunciamiento de la Cámara de Diputados sobre la delegación de facultades legislativas solicitadas por un plazo de 120 días. La Comisión de Constitución se declaró en sesión permanente el 31 de agosto de 2026 para agilizar el estudio de esta propuesta. El pedido gubernamental comprende un total de 66 medidas para combatir el crimen organizado y dinamizar la economía de las pequeñas empresas. Actualmente el trámite se encuentra en la Comisión de Constitución y, según detalló el presidente del Senado, Miguel Torres (Fuerza Popular), espera la opinión de al menos otras ocho comisiones más.

articles.title: Keiko Fujimori pide rapidez al Congreso: “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”
articles.summary: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para recuperar el orden y enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada.
articles.body_text: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso de la República a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada. “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”, exclamó. Durante su visita a San Martín, Fujimori señaló que el Ejecutivo busca contar con las facultades especiales para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como “grupos hostiles”, “grupos terroristas”, como parte de las medidas planteadas para combatir la delincuencia organizada. “Invocamos al Congreso que puedan analizar este pedido de facultades de una manera rápida”, expresó. La mandataria también sostuvo que se necesita recuperar la capacidad operativa del servicio de inteligencia, que, según indicó, se ha visto limitada durante los últimos años. Otro de los puntos mencionados fue la necesidad de una actuación conjunta de las Fuerzas Armadas y la Policía Nacional. En ese sentido, señaló que ambas instituciones deben tener una mayor participación en el control de los establecimientos penitenciarios. Fujimori agregó que el pedido de facultades contempla un mecanismo para agilizar la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. “Necesitamos estas facultades para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como grupos hostiles, como grupos terroristas. Necesitamos fortalecer el servicio de inteligencia porque desde hace unos años no tiene capacidad operativa. Necesitamos que las Fuerzas Armadas y Policía Nacional actúen de manera conjunta y también tomen mayor control de los penales”, remarcó la mandataria.

articles.body_text: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, se decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga. Carlos Vilela, director nacional de Educación del JNE, declaró a Canal N que iniciarán el diálogo para alcanzar consensos con las agrupaciones políticas. “Buscamos de manera democrática poder decidir si ellos quieren que participe, por ejemplo, el primer candidato de la lista que postulan (...) Posiblemente se decida lo mismo, o solo se decida como en elecciones presidenciales, que solo vayan los candidatos. Eso lo vamos a saber este día lunes”. Renovación Popular ha enviado un pedido escrito al JNE para permitir la presentación de Rafael López Aliaga en el debate para la Municipalidad de Lima a pesar de que es candidato a teniente alcalde y no a la alcaldía, ya que este puesto estaba ocupado por Luis Rubio, quien renunció a su postulación. La cita técnica del lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 también servirá para definir las metodologías oficiales de los encuentros democráticos. Asimismo, los representantes partidarios elegirán a los profesionales independientes que asumirán las tareas de moderación en las transmisiones. “Nosotros invitamos a los representantes de Renovación Popular para que puedan asistir y ser partícipes del diálogo de esa propuesta”. Finalmente, Vilela exhortó al partido de López Aliaga que se sume a firmar el Pacto Ético Electoral de forma extemporánea, como lo hicieron el Partido Democrático Verde y Podemos Perú. El proceso electoral cuenta con más de 13,000 candidatos aptos para las elecciones del domingo 4 de octubre de 2026. Los debates representan un reto logístico importante para el JNE debido al alto número de postulaciones inscritas a nivel nacional. Los debates oficiales del JNE se desarrollarán de manera descentralizada desde el martes 8 de setiembre hasta el sábado 19 de setiembre de 2026. Para la Municipalidad de Lima, la exposición de propuestas quedó programada para el domingo 21 y el lunes 22 de setiembre de 2026. El cronograma electoral establece que el debate regional del Callao se realizará el miércoles 16 de setiembre de 2026. Por su parte, la región de Lima Provincias tendrá dos jornadas de diálogo democrático programadas para el jueves 17 y el viernes 18 de setiembre de 2026.

articles.body_text: El Consejo de Ministros que lidera Luis Galarreta sesiona hoy viernes 4 de setiembre desde las 6 p.m. en el Palacio de Gobierno de Lima. Esta cita de carácter ordinario reúne a los integrantes del gabinete para evaluar, entre otros puntos, la Política General del Gobierno. Según la agenda oficial, esta iniciativa está comprendida en un proyecto de Decreto Supremo que aprueba esta política para el periodo 2026-2031 y busca “ordenar el Estado para recuperar la seguridad, destrabar el crecimiento y convertir las decisiones públicas en resultados, propuesto por la Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros”. Horas atrás, la presidenta Keiko Fujimori participó en actividades oficiales visitando el BAP Paita en la Base Naval del Callao, acompañada por los ministros Rafael Belaúnde y Marco Vinelli. La agenda de trabajo del Consejo de Ministros de este viernes incluye la presentación de un reporte sobre el cumplimiento del Plan Multisectorial ante Lluvias Intensas. La Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros expondrá las acciones preventivas frente a riesgos climáticos ejecutadas durante el primer semestre del año 2026. El Ministerio de la Mujer expondrá las respuestas del sector frente a los casos de violencia sexual contra menores en Condorcanqui. Por su parte, el Ministerio del Interior presentará el proyecto de ley que facilita el chatarreo de vehículos de la Policía Nacional. El gabinete analizará las solicitudes de prórroga del estado de emergencia para distritos de Chupaca y Huancayo afectados por movimientos sísmicos. Asimismo, el Ministerio de Defensa someterá a votación la resolución legislativa que autoriza el ingreso de personal militar extranjero al territorio nacional. El Ejecutivo espera el pronunciamiento de la Cámara de Diputados sobre la delegación de facultades legislativas solicitadas por un plazo de 120 días. La Comisión de Constitución se declaró en sesión permanente el 31 de agosto de 2026 para agilizar el estudio de esta propuesta. El pedido gubernamental comprende un total de 66 medidas para combatir el crimen organizado y dinamizar la economía de las pequeñas empresas. Actualmente el trámite se encuentra en la Comisión de Constitución y, según detalló el presidente del Senado, Miguel Torres (Fuerza Popular), espera la opinión de al menos otras ocho comisiones más.

articles.body_text: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso de la República a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada. “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”, exclamó. Durante su visita a San Martín, Fujimori señaló que el Ejecutivo busca contar con las facultades especiales para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como “grupos hostiles”, “grupos terroristas”, como parte de las medidas planteadas para combatir la delincuencia organizada. “Invocamos al Congreso que puedan analizar este pedido de facultades de una manera rápida”, expresó. La mandataria también sostuvo que se necesita recuperar la capacidad operativa del servicio de inteligencia, que, según indicó, se ha visto limitada durante los últimos años. Otro de los puntos mencionados fue la necesidad de una actuación conjunta de las Fuerzas Armadas y la Policía Nacional. En ese sentido, señaló que ambas instituciones deben tener una mayor participación en el control de los establecimientos penitenciarios. Fujimori agregó que el pedido de facultades contempla un mecanismo para agilizar la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. “Necesitamos estas facultades para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como grupos hostiles, como grupos terroristas. Necesitamos fortalecer el servicio de inteligencia porque desde hace unos años no tiene capacidad operativa. Necesitamos que las Fuerzas Armadas y Policía Nacional actúen de manera conjunta y también tomen mayor control de los penales”, remarcó la mandataria.

articles.body_text: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, se decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga. Carlos Vilela, director nacional de Educación del JNE, declaró a Canal N que iniciarán el diálogo para alcanzar consensos con las agrupaciones políticas. “Buscamos de manera democrática poder decidir si ellos quieren que participe, por ejemplo, el primer candidato de la lista que postulan (...) Posiblemente se decida lo mismo, o solo se decida como en elecciones presidenciales, que solo vayan los candidatos. Eso lo vamos a saber este día lunes”. Renovación Popular ha enviado un pedido escrito al JNE para permitir la presentación de Rafael López Aliaga en el debate para la Municipalidad de Lima a pesar de que es candidato a teniente alcalde y no a la alcaldía, ya que este puesto estaba ocupado por Luis Rubio, quien renunció a su postulación. La cita técnica del lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 también servirá para definir las metodologías oficiales de los encuentros democráticos. Asimismo, los representantes partidarios elegirán a los profesionales independientes que asumirán las tareas de moderación en las transmisiones. “Nosotros invitamos a los representantes de Renovación Popular para que puedan asistir y ser partícipes del diálogo de esa propuesta”. Finalmente, Vilela exhortó al partido de López Aliaga que se sume a firmar el Pacto Ético Electoral de forma extemporánea, como lo hicieron el Partido Democrático Verde y Podemos Perú. El proceso electoral cuenta con más de 13,000 candidatos aptos para las elecciones del domingo 4 de octubre de 2026. Los debates representan un reto logístico importante para el JNE debido al alto número de postulaciones inscritas a nivel nacional. Los debates oficiales del JNE se desarrollarán de manera descentralizada desde el martes 8 de setiembre hasta el sábado 19 de setiembre de 2026. Para la Municipalidad de Lima, la exposición de propuestas quedó programada para el domingo 21 y el lunes 22 de setiembre de 2026. El cronograma electoral establece que el debate regional del Callao se realizará el miércoles 16 de setiembre de 2026. Por su parte, la región de Lima Provincias tendrá dos jornadas de diálogo democrático programadas para el jueves 17 y el viernes 18 de setiembre de 2026.

articles.body_text: El Consejo de Ministros que lidera Luis Galarreta sesiona hoy viernes 4 de setiembre desde las 6 p.m. en el Palacio de Gobierno de Lima. Esta cita de carácter ordinario reúne a los integrantes del gabinete para evaluar, entre otros puntos, la Política General del Gobierno. Según la agenda oficial, esta iniciativa está comprendida en un proyecto de Decreto Supremo que aprueba esta política para el periodo 2026-2031 y busca “ordenar el Estado para recuperar la seguridad, destrabar el crecimiento y convertir las decisiones públicas en resultados, propuesto por la Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros”. Horas atrás, la presidenta Keiko Fujimori participó en actividades oficiales visitando el BAP Paita en la Base Naval del Callao, acompañada por los ministros Rafael Belaúnde y Marco Vinelli. La agenda de trabajo del Consejo de Ministros de este viernes incluye la presentación de un reporte sobre el cumplimiento del Plan Multisectorial ante Lluvias Intensas. La Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros expondrá las acciones preventivas frente a riesgos climáticos ejecutadas durante el primer semestre del año 2026. El Ministerio de la Mujer expondrá las respuestas del sector frente a los casos de violencia sexual contra menores en Condorcanqui. Por su parte, el Ministerio del Interior presentará el proyecto de ley que facilita el chatarreo de vehículos de la Policía Nacional. El gabinete analizará las solicitudes de prórroga del estado de emergencia para distritos de Chupaca y Huancayo afectados por movimientos sísmicos. Asimismo, el Ministerio de Defensa someterá a votación la resolución legislativa que autoriza el ingreso de personal militar extranjero al territorio nacional. El Ejecutivo espera el pronunciamiento de la Cámara de Diputados sobre la delegación de facultades legislativas solicitadas por un plazo de 120 días. La Comisión de Constitución se declaró en sesión permanente el 31 de agosto de 2026 para agilizar el estudio de esta propuesta. El pedido gubernamental comprende un total de 66 medidas para combatir el crimen organizado y dinamizar la economía de las pequeñas empresas. Actualmente el trámite se encuentra en la Comisión de Constitución y, según detalló el presidente del Senado, Miguel Torres (Fuerza Popular), espera la opinión de al menos otras ocho comisiones más.

articles.body_text: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso de la República a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada. “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”, exclamó. La mandataria también sostuvo que se necesita recuperar la capacidad operativa del servicio de inteligencia, que, según indicó, se ha visto limitada durante los últimos años. Otro de los puntos mencionados fue la necesidad de una actuación conjunta de las Fuerzas Armadas y la Policía Nacional. En ese sentido, señaló que ambas instituciones deben tener una mayor participación en el control de los establecimientos penitenciarios. Fujimori agregó que el pedido de facultades contempla un mecanismo para agilizar la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. “Necesitamos estas facultades para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como grupos hostiles, como grupos terroristas. articles.body_text: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso de la República a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada. “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”, exclamó. Durante su visita a San Martín, Fujimori señaló que el Ejecutivo busca contar con las facultades especiales para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como “grupos hostiles”, “grupos terroristas”, como parte de las medidas planteadas para combatir la delincuencia organizada. “Invocamos al Congreso que puedan analizar este pedido de facultades de una manera rápida”, expresó. La mandataria también sostuvo que se necesita recuperar la capacidad operativa del servicio de inteligencia, que, según indicó, se ha visto limitada durante los últimos años. Otro de los puntos mencionados fue la necesidad de una actuación conjunta de las Fuerzas Armadas y la Policía Nacional. En ese sentido, señaló que ambas instituciones deben tener una mayor participación en el control de los establecimientos penitenciarios. Fujimori agregó que el pedido de facultades contempla un mecanismo para agilizar la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. “Necesitamos estas facultades para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como grupos hostiles, como grupos terroristas. articles.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Last month, a Claude user noticed his account was consuming tokens even though he wasn't working. Anthropic has since warned users about hackers.
articles.body_text: On August 4, Grant De Swardt, an independent AI consultant in East Sussex, U.K., noticed something strange going on with his Claude Max 20x account. He hadn’t been working that day, yet his token usage was climbing. The next day, he disabled everything he had attached to Claude and did not work with it. Token consumption again increased. “In the clearest controlled interval, it increased from 45% to 55% while I performed no work, scheduled Cowork tasks were paused or completed, Dispatch/cloud execution was disabled, and there was no corresponding active local Claude Code task,” De Swardt told TechCrunch. What was eating up his token allowance? He had no idea, so he contacted Anthropic and asked for an itemized list. Anthropic didn’t provide one, but it agreed something was off. It suspended his paid account, invalidated all of his sessions and server-side Claude Code tokens, and issued him a partial refund of £44.49 for the remaining time on his $200-per-month subscription. The suspension wreaked havok on his business, he told TechCrunch. His job is to help small and mid-size businesses set up agents — a sort of forward-deployed engineer for hire — for tasks like automatically loading purchase-order data from emails into the accounting software. As a sole proprietor, he relies on agents throughout his whole business, too: daily admin tasks, website design, coding. “Like everything is just running through AI these days,” he said. After investigating, Anthropic told De Swardt it found the culprit: A compromised Claude session key was used to mint unauthorized Claude Code OAuth tokens. The company told him the account “appeared to have been used by an unauthorized-looking third-party service to handle activity for other people, but they could not determine how it obtained access,” he told TechCrunch. “They say the evidence is consistent either with credentials/session data being taken without my knowledge, or with the account having been connected to an outside service.” In other words, a hacker was able to obtain access to De Swardt’s account and was covertly siphoning off his tokens. Because account support tracks total usage but not itemized usage, even upon request, this kind of theft could have gone on for months undetected. He posted his experience on Reddit and after 80 comments, he discovered he was not alone. One person claimed that their account “was auto-upgraded without my consent, my credit card got charged, and the usage shot from 0% to 100% automatically without me even touching it.” Another saw usage go from 0 to 49% in 12 minutes, when all they had used it for was a couple of prompts and a web search. One Claude user said their account burned through its max tokens every day for three days without them using it at all; this person then created a GitHub report about it. Like with the Reddit post, other users shared similar experiences there, too. Two of them posted emails from Anthropic where the company had — to its credit — identified and warned them that their tokens were being stolen. “We have recently become aware of a bad actor that is using common infostealer malware to steal Claude login sessions from people’s computers, then using those login sessions to access Claude accounts and consume their usage,” the email read. Infostealers are a type of malware that installs itself on a user’s computer and steals saved passwords, session data, and login credentials. When Anthropic saw suspicious activity, it signed the users out, invalidated existing authorizations, issued some refunds, and warned them that they may have malware.

articles.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Cognition's valuation multiple is higher than Cursor's was before selling to SpaceX.
articles.body_text: Cognition, the startup developing coding assistant Devin, announced it raised $2 billion at a $48 billion valuation. The round, which comes just four months after Cognition’s previous fundraise at a $26 billion valuation , was led by Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, and Avenir. The startup’s soaring valuation signals that VCs still see room for multiple major players to capture meaningful market share in AI coding, one of the technology’s most significant applications. Cognition said that since announcing its last fundraise in May, its annualized run-rate revenue has grown from $492 million to $900 million. While the startup didn’t explain how it calculates that run-rate revenue, the metric is usually defined as a month’s top line multiplied by 12. Cursor, another popular coding assistant, was in talks in April to raise capital at a $50 billion valuation before agreeing to sell to SpaceX for $60 billion later that month. At the time of the funding talks, Cursor’s annualized revenue had surpassed $2 billion. This means Cognition currently commands a higher revenue multiple than Cursor did in the spring. Cursor ultimately sold to SpaceX largely because it was severely compute-constrained, according to investors familiar with its financials. It is unclear whether Cognition will face similar compute shortages. Cognition leases an Nvidia server cluster that costs hundreds of millions of dollars annually, which could push its total cash burn to $800 million this year, The Information reported . Like Cursor did before joining SpaceX, Cognition is training its own model based on open source alternatives. Over time, reducing its reliance on expensive third-party models from OpenAI and Anthropic will help cut costs and bring the company closer to breakeven. Cognition is expected to reach $4 billion to $5 billion in annualized revenue by the end of 2026, according to The Information. By comparison, TechCrunch reported in the spring that Cursor was on track to surpass $6 billion by year-end. Still, it’s notable that a16z, a major backer of Cursor, which made a killing when it sold to SpaceX, is back to lead a round in a Cursor competitor. Founded in 2024 by math prodigy Scott Wu, Cognition counts Mercedes-Benz, NASA, Goldman Sachs, and Citi among its major enterprise customers. articles.title: OpenAI fought dirty on career-making math problem, says NYU mathematician | TechCrunch
articles.summary: There is a $1 million bounty for the first person providing a solution to the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem.
articles.body_text: NYU mathematics professor Tristan Buckmaster announced three proofs on Tuesday with a preliminary finding on one of the major unsolved problems in theoretical mathematics. The findings, made in collaboration with Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge and using both Codex and Claude AI models, are significant in themselves — but they’re also accompanied by an unusual controversy surrounding OpenAI’s attempts to solve the same problem. “There is another part of this story,” Buckmaster wrote in his statement announcing the proofs, “and one that, honestly, I very much wish I did not have to be concerned with.” According to the statement, a parallel effort by OpenAI built on their work before it became public, leading to a tangle of academic rivalries and conflicting claims. Shortly after the Buckmaster’s statement, OpenAI published a full proof of the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem , which Buckmaster’s findings had taken steps towards. According to OpenAI, the proof was discovered by an unreleased next-generation model, which has tackled a range of different unsolved problems over the past week. All told, the week-long effort consumed 300 billion output tokens — $22.5 million worth of compute, if charged at current Astra rates . The Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem is one of the seven Millennium Prize problems — a set of major unsolved math problems, each carrying a $1 million bounty from Clay Mathematics Institute for the first person or group to provide a solution. The Navier-Stokes equations are widely used in fluid mechanics but poorly understood in theoretical terms. A solution would represent a significant advance in the collective understanding of mathematical physics. While Buckmaster and Alpöge were finalizing their own results, they learned that “information about our progress had been passed to OpenAI.” When they contacted OpenAI, they were told that OpenAI had already achieved a full proof of the central problem. But when they asked follow-up questions about when OpenAI had begun its research into the problem and how much human input was involved, the answers became more evasive. “It emerged that an entire team had been working on the problem,” Buckmaster said, “and that an insane amount of compute had been used…. Eventually, it was agreed that [the first prompt] had been sent in the past few days, after information about our work had reached OpenAI.” If true, that would suggest the OpenAI team had become convinced that Buckmaster and Alpöge’s approach was the right one, and decided to use its material advantage in computing resources to reach a formal proof first. OpenAI’s post confirms much of this timeline, specifically saying that the latest effort began on September 1, inspired by rumors that two Millenium Prize problem had been solved. Additionally, the post confirms the ongoing conversations with Buckmaster and Alpöge. Although the problem is widely pursued among mathematicians, the specific tactic taken by Buckmaster and his collaborator is far less common. As a result, Buckmaster found it suspicious that OpenAI ended up taking the same approach at the same time. “The route to the Clay problem through a smooth force, options c and d in Fefferman’s statement of the problem, is the route Luis and Diego opened and the one Levent and I had quietly chosen to attack,” Buckmaster wrote. “Almost nobody else I know of was working on it,” he continued. “It is not the direction one arrives at in a few days by giving a model the problem statement.” While Alpöge is employed by Anthropic, he was not conducting this research on the company’s behalf. As a result, the duo used a mix of models, relying primarily on OpenAI’s Codex in their work. Even so, Alpöge’s affiliation with a rival lab seems to have been a sore point for OpenAI, and Buckmaster alleges that Bubeck asked him to remove Alpöge’s credit as part of a proposed compromise. When Buckmaster pushed to make the dispute public, he says that Bubeck replied: “Why would you ruin your career?” Buckmaster says that when he pushed back, Bubeck followed up with: “If you don’t want me to be nice, then I don’t have to be nice.”

articles.title: Chrome is now shipping updates every 2 weeks as AI changes the security landscape | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Google is speeding up Chrome’s release schedule to ship security patches and new features faster.
articles.body_text: Chrome has officially switched from a four- to a two-week release schedule, as Google promised earlier this year, with Tuesday’s launch of Chrome 153 on desktop, iOS, and Android. The shift to faster releases is tied to Chrome’s evolving security strategy in the AI era, the company explained. As automated AI tools and community bug reports have pushed up the volume of patches and updates, Google says that a shorter release cycle makes it easier to manage security fixes. This is also critical because faster-moving threats, some of which can also be attributed to AI, can be better addressed by shrinking the window between landing a fix in the public codebase and getting that fix to end users, the company notes. A shorter release schedule would help keep the “N-day” patch gap — the gap between when a security vulnerability is known and when it gets patched — as small as possible. Faster releases have another benefit, too: They can help Chrome ship features faster. This is also key in the AI era, as AI-assisted software development has enabled a host of new browser competitors to emerge. While OpenAI’s web browser, ChatGPT Atlas , has been shut down, there are still plenty of other alternative browsers looking to carve out a piece of Chrome’s market for themselves, including Brave , Dia , Opera Neon , Perplexity’s Comet , DuckDuckGo’s browser, and more . Plus, Google is experimenting with adding more AI features to Chrome and then rapidly iterating on those additions, which also demands faster updates. The move to a two-week release schedule benefits the broader web as well. Because of Chrome’s position as the most-used browser globally, such changes can help set the standard for the industry. Mozilla , Microsoft , and Brave have already begun adopting a faster two-week schedule, following Chrome’s lead. This is not the first time Chrome has adjusted its release schedule to enable faster patch management. The company first moved to a four-week release cycle in 2021 , down from six weeks, after establishing its principles of “ release early, release often ” over a decade prior.
